list.searchPlaceholder: Search by project name or site address
list.empty: No projects yet. Create a new project to get started.
list.createHint: New projects are private by default. The customer home message starts from the company template.

home.saved: Customer home saved. Customers see the change right away.
home.previewNotice: The preview shows only what customers can see.
home.sectionsLabel: Customer home section order and visibility
home.privateProjectNotice: This project is still private, so customers cannot open it yet.
home.pageImagesHint: Change page images in Settings > Templates. Here you only choose whether to show them.

settings.publicHint: Turn this on so invited customers can open this project.
settings.phaseHint: The current phase shown on the customer home. It is not calculated from photos or schedules.
settings.archiveHint: Archived projects are hidden from customers and field crews. You can restore them at any time.

participants.empty: No participants yet. Invite a customer or field crew.
participants.confirmRightHint: Only customers with the confirm right can confirm designs and materials.
participants.periodHint: Leave blank for no limit. Dates use Korea time and include both the start and end dates.

myProjects.empty: No projects to show. Projects appear here once your company makes them visible.

archive.title: Archive this project?
archive.body: Customers and field crews will no longer see this project. You can restore it from the archive at any time.

revokeInvite.title: Revoke this invitation link?
revokeInvite.body: No one will be able to join using this link.

revokeParticipant.title: Remove {name} from this project?
revokeParticipant.body: They will lose access immediately. Their past activity stays on record.

restore.title: Restore this project?
restore.body: Once restored, customers and field crews can see it again according to its visibility.

state.archived: This project is archived. Customers and field crews can’t see it until it’s restored.

invite.created: Invitation link created. Copy and share it now — you won’t be able to see it again.
invite.reissueHint: Creating a new link for the same email automatically revokes the previous one.
invite.noEmailHint: No email is sent. Copy the link and share it yourself, for example via a messenger.
invite.closeWarning: You cannot see this link again after closing. Copy it now.

account.hint: Creating an account emails the ID (email) and a temporary password. If the email already has an account, it is only added to this project.
account.created: Account created. The email couldn't be sent, so share the temporary password yourself.
account.assignedExisting: This person already has an account, so they were added to this project.
account.mailNotSent: The email couldn't be sent. Copy the details below and share them directly.
account.closeWarning: Once you close this, you can't see the temporary password again. Resend it if needed.
account.alreadyActive: This account already set its own password. Use a reset link if they forgot it.

createPermission.requested: Asked the company admin for permission to create projects.
createPermission.pending: Permission requested — waiting for the company admin.
